title: Calibrate a torque limiting clutch against two proof loads
context: A torque limiter must transmit ordinary load and slip before a higher load can damage equipment. This trainer tests one setting against both loads.
setup: Use the official bimanual YAM station. All coordinates are metres in the station frame. The unpowered fixture root is at x 0.25 and y 0 on the table. The grey base is 300 by 300 by 8 mm. The blue 70 g input has a 75 mm crank and a 22 mm diameter grip. The orange 60 g output lever is 90 by 10 by 10 mm. The yellow 20 g light load block uses a 30 N/m spring with 40 mm travel. The red 20 g heavy load block uses a 70 N/m spring with 40 mm travel. A green 50 g selector moves 30 mm along x to engage the heavy block. The grey 30 g preload slider starts at x 0.15 and y 0.12 and moves 20 mm along y. Both input and output start at zero angle. All joints start at zero displacement. A green reference mark shows 20 degrees. Geometry is rigid matte training hardware. Material specific deformation and wear are not simulated. Exact component offsets and masses are in task.py.
scoring: Score 0 after robot contact with the output or either load block or invalid joint state. Otherwise score 1 when both proofs hold and both grippers are open and all robot contacts are clear and angular speeds are below 0.05 rad/s and linear speeds below 4 mm/s. Score 0.75 for both proofs before release. Score 0.5 for the light proof. Score 0.25 for light spring compression above 5 mm and input angle above 10 degrees. Otherwise score 0. The light proof requires ten consecutive samples with selector below 5 mm and input above 20 degrees and output above 18 degrees and slip below 3 degrees and light compression above 10 mm. Return input and output within 3 degrees of zero before heavy testing. The heavy proof requires twenty samples with selector above 28 mm and heavy compression above 2 mm. Output range must be below 2 degrees while input advances more than 7 degrees. Final input must exceed 40 degrees and output must be between 8 and 18.5 degrees and slip must exceed 20 degrees. Changing preload more than 0.5 mm clears both proofs. Full success must hold for one second.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. Reset input and output angles and both springs and selector and preload to zero. Recreate the scene and clear score history. Use no human hands near the moving mechanism during a physical trial.
fidelity: Native articulated rigid bodies and collision driven spring loads. Clutch capacity is an ideal passive velocity damper with force limit 0.010 plus 4 times preload displacement in metres. Capacity ranges from 0.010 to 0.090 Nm. It is not a friction disc or thermal wear model. The preload changes the torque limit only. No output angle target or object teleport is used. Robot contact monitoring forbids direct output and load manipulation.
instruction: Adjust the grey preload control so the clutch carries the light proof load but slips against the heavier proof load. Use the blue input handle to test each load. Pull the green selector fully toward the output lever for the heavy test. Return the input to its start before selecting heavy. Keep one unchanged preload setting for both tests. Do not touch the orange output lever or the two spring load blocks. Release both hands. The trainer is unpowered.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz. This is 120 seconds of control time.
